questions.prompt: Explain why the sum of two polynomials is always a polynomial.
questions.prompt_markup: Explain why the sum of two polynomials is always a polynomial.
questions.correct_answer: Adding combines like terms by adding their coefficients. The coefficients stay real numbers and the exponents stay whole numbers, so the result is a polynomial.
questions.grading_note: Any equivalent explanation (closure: the result has the same form).

questions.prompt_markup: The difference of two polynomials is always a polynomial.
